name: Death List
landing_text: $(5)Death List$() is your virtual Avenger soul ledger. Press $(b)Ctrl+H$() to open it at the live Soul Ledger. $(br2)$(6)H$(): summon / recall. $(br)$(5)Shift+H$(): unbind aimed soul. $(br2)Soul counts, kills, charges, and discovered recipes are synced from the server each time you open it.
